node.title: KoalaBear m12 outer-subdegree route cut
node.closure: primitive degree-five subdegrees plus challenge-field cyclic exclusion
node.statement: At inner degree 12, the outer degree-five map has one challenge-field-rational pole of order five and five distinct challenge-field-rational simple zeros. Primitive degree-five monodromy excludes transverse outer subdegree three. Subdegree one would make the cover cyclic and hence, after rational normalization, a fifth-power map; fifth-power injectivity on F_(2130706433^6) contradicts five distinct rational zeros. Thus only (r,delta)=(2,24),(4,12) survive, reducing the global transverse frontier from 26 to 24 types. No m12 close, owner, charge, u2 close, cap 68, or row close is claimed.
